summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next starts from checkpoint revisions whose MTP layer is MXFP8, such as the QAD export qad-step5500-ple1000
compatibility: No user action required. An explicit speculative-config is used as given.
details: The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and DeepSeek-V4 profiles run the MTP drafter's experts on b12x, which takes NVFP4 and MXFP4 experts. The QAD revision qad-step5500-ple1000 of local-inference-lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 exports its MTP experts as MXFP8, so starting it with --revision stopped at model load with "moe_backend='b12x' is not supported for MXFP8 MoE".

At launch the runtime now reads hf_quant_config.json of the selected revision. When the MTP experts use a format b12x does not run, it leaves the drafter's MoE backend to vLLM, which picks Marlin for MXFP8, and logs one line saying so. Reported by shieldstarx.
